detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to Machine Party. In this series of dangerous, and some would say highly illegal, party games you will have to use every trick in the book to survive. Play through classic party game formats and new twists on the genre for sessions of fun, screaming, and horror. 

Features 

  • A collection of uniquely violent party games 

  • Support for 2 - 4 players 

  • An industrial soundtrack by Alex Peipman

  • Customize your test subject

  • Multiple devious ways of screwing your friends over
